# Scholarships.plus

> A comprehensive global scholarship database connecting international students with funding opportunities across 2026-2027, featuring scholarships, internships, contests, and grants from top institutions worldwide.

Scholarships.plus aggregates financial aid opportunities for undergraduate and graduate students across multiple continents. The platform specializes in country-specific scholarship directories, competitive contests, and internship funding with a strong focus on Canada, USA, Europe, and Africa.

## Key Topics

- Financial Aid & Grants
- International Students
- 2026-2027 Scholarships
- Study Abroad
- Scholarship Database
- Undergraduate & Graduate
- Canada Scholarships
- USA Scholarships
- Europe (Germany, France, UK, Netherlands)
- Africa Scholarships
- Internship Opportunities
- Scholarship Contests
- STEM & Women in Tech
- Tuition Funding
- Global Opportunities

## Scholarship Databases by Type

- [Global Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships): Main scholarship database with global opportunities for 2026-2027
- [Global Scholarships for Internship | All Locations](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/internship/all-locations): Internship scholarships directory covering global locations
- [Global Awarding Contests and Competitions](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/contest/all-locations): Scholarship contests and competitions database for all countries

## Country-Specific Scholarships

- [USA Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/united-states): USA scholarships and grants from top institutions like Stanford
- [Canada Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/canada): Canada scholarships and grants database for 2026-2027
- [Germany Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/germany): Germany scholarships and grants for undergraduate and graduate
- [UK Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/united-kingdom): UK scholarships and grants for international students
- [France Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/france): France scholarships and grants for international students 2026-2027
- [Netherlands Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/netherlands): Netherlands scholarships and grants for international students
- [Nigeria Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/nigeria): Nigeria scholarships including Fulbright and DAAD programs
- [Africa Scholarships & Grants | 2026-2027](https://scholarships.plus/scholarships/all-degrees/africa): Africa scholarships database for undergraduate and postgraduate

## Featured Scholarships & Opportunities

- [Nellie McClung Trailblazer Scholarship 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/nellie-mcclung-trailblazer-scholarship-2026): Nellie McClung STEAM scholarship for female students in Canada
- [Manitoba Arts Council Scholarships 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/manitoba-arts-council-scholarships-2026): Manitoba Arts Council scholarships for arts students 2026
- [CNIB Post-Secondary Scholarships & Bursaries 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/cnib-post-secondary-scholarships-bursaries-2026): CNIB scholarships for students with visual disabilities in Canada
- [Women in Trades, Engineering, and Technology Scholarship by Nova Scotia Power 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/women-in-trades-engineering-and-technology-scholarship-by-nova-scotia-power-2026): Women in STEM trades and technology scholarship by Nova Scotia
- [Emerging Leader Scholarship by Nova Scotia Power 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/emerging-leader-scholarship-by-nova-scotia-power-2026): Nova Scotia Power emerging leader engineering scholarship 2026
- [European Union Funded Traineeship 2026](https://scholarships.plus/scholarship/european-union-funded-traineeship-2026): EU-funded traineeship at African Union in Ethiopia 2026
